body:
# 🛡️ Totem Reminder

**Totem Reminder** helps you avoid one of the scariest mistakes in Minecraft: forgetting to keep a Totem of Undying in your offhand.

Perfect for Hardcore players, survival worlds, and anyone who wants a simple safety reminder. ⚠️

## ✨ Features

- 🛡️ Alerts you when your offhand does not contain a Totem of Undying
- 📢 Shows a customizable actionbar warning
- 🎵 Choose your alert sound
- 🎨 Change the warning text color
- ⏱️ Customize text duration and repeat interval
- 🔊 Adjust alert volume
- ⌨️ Configurable keybinds through Minecraft Controls
- 🌍 Includes multiple language translations
- 💻 Client-side only

## ⌨️ Default Keybinds

- `O` - Open settings menu
- `U` - Toggle alerts on/off

Both keybinds can be changed from Minecraft’s normal keybind settings.

## 📦 Compatibility

Totem Reminder supports **Minecraft 1.21 through 1.21.11** with Fabric.

Use the jar that matches your Minecraft version range:

- `1.21 - 1.21.5`
- `1.21.6 - 1.21.8`
- `1.21.9 - 1.21.11`

## ✅ Requirements

- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

## 💡 Why use it?

Because forgetting your totem for even a few seconds can be enough to lose a world.

Totem Reminder keeps the warning simple, clean, and customizable, so you can focus on playing while still staying protected. 🧡
